title: sdr-daily-scratchpad-samira-khan-2026-03-19
content:
Daily goals:
- 40 dials, 60 emails, 6 meaningful conversations
- Book 1 discovery demo or get a solid next step (POC intro, budget owner intro)
- Clear top-of-funnel blockers for A/C accounts

Quick context / notes:
- Focus: mid-market ecom + fintech (latency-sensitive infra).
- Momentum from last week: demo request from BrightCart; need to follow up on infra questions.
- Primary call list pulled from SFDC view: MQLs past 30 days + product-usage signals.

AM call block (9:00 - 11:30 PT)
- 9:05 AM — BrightCart (Lauren M.) — LEFT VM yesterday, referenced cost/latency report. Today objective: get intro to infra lead (CTO/Platform).
  Notes: "We shaved 30% token cost for another retailer; ask about monthly inference spend and latency SLOs."
  Next step: send short ROI email + request 20-min intro w/ infra lead.
  Status: left-voicemail

- 9:30 AM — FinPulse (Raj P.) — warm, trial user of hosted API. Concern: data residency.
  Notes: ask if they evaluated Dedicated vs Private. Offer to connect with Solutions Eng.
  Talking points: KMS/HSM options, VPC private deployment timeline, SLAs.
  Next step: schedule 30-min with Lina (SE).
  Status: call scheduled 3/20 11am PT (confirm via email)

- 10:00 AM — NovaRewards (A/C) — inbound trial ended, no response to last demo follow-up.
  Notes: try value-based subject line: "Reduce inference cost for personalization — quick ask"
  Disposition codes: NG if no reply after 2nd follow-up.

LUNCH follow-up (12:00 - 1:00 PT)
- Send follow-up templates (see below) to: BrightCart, NovaRewards, CityBank (Raj replaced), Atlas Logistics.
- Log disposition + update SFDC notes.

PM block (2:00 - 4:30 PT)
- 2:15 PM — Cold call block: 20 dials (use A/B script #1 for fintech).
- 3:00 PM — Cadence review with Evan (quick 15) — share which templates are converting this week.

Top accounts to prioritize (this week):
1) BrightCart — high ACV potential, demo + infra intro needed
2) FinPulse (trial) — compliance/residency blocker, SE intro next
3) CityBank — regulatory sensitivity, Private deployment possible
4) Atlas Logistics — cost savings pitch for peak season

Email templates / subject lines (short + test variations):
- Subject A: "Quick question about inference costs at {company}"
- Subject B: "How {company} can lower per-request costs for recommendations"
- Body short (for BrightCart style):
  Hi {First},

  Quick note — we helped a retailer cut inference unit cost ~30% while keeping 99th pct latency intact. Would it make sense to intro me to your infra lead to see if this is relevant? 20 min.

  Thanks,
  Samira

Call script A (cold):
- Intro: name, one-liner (Redwood Inference: predictable, cost-efficient LLM inference)
- Hook: "We recently helped a company in {vertical} cut inference costs by ~30% while holding latency. Curious if inference costs or unpredictable latency are top of mind for you?"
- If interest: set 20-min intro + propose next steps (SE deep-dive).
- If no interest: ask who owns infra/ML for a quick intro.

Dispositions + next-action shorthand I use:
- LVM = left voicemail (use follow-up template A2)
- INT = interested (schedule meeting + add Lina)
- NG = not a good fit / no budget
- RES = requested resources (share perf benchmark doc)

Tasks / To-do (high priority):
- [ ] Email BrightCart ROI note + ask for infra intro (today)
- [ ] Confirm FinPulse meeting with Lina + share SOW template
- [ ] Update SFDC for NovaRewards and move to 2-step follow-up sequence
- [ ] Log all call outcomes into Gong by EOD

Random notes / freeform thoughts:
- Consider adding a "cost-per-100k-tokens" table to the BrightCart email (quick stat).
- Playbook update idea: add specific objection responses for "privacy/data residency" — link to SE FAQ.
- Follow-up cadence tweak: try 3-day gap between email 1 and 2 instead of 5 for trial users.

End-of-day quick recap (fill after EOD):
- Dials: ____
- Conversations: ____
- Meetings booked: ____
- Notable asks: ____

Last checked: 2026-03-19 16:40 PT
